correctness.rationale: The standard one-pole Artin–Schreier genus and finite-place splitting rules reduce absence of degree-six places to eleven explicit trace conditions. An exact seven-orbit dual relation annihilates every degree-0..20 polynomial and gives a parity contradiction for any lower genus. A degree-21 witness satisfies the nine degree-six inertness and two degree-three splitting conditions; its extension point counts independently confirm B6=0. The packaged standalone program replayed every exact arithmetic identity.

value.rationale: A natural minimum-genus extremal question for one-pole covers receives a sharp answer, not an arbitrary finite subsample: lower genera excluded uniformly by a compact trace-duality certificate, and a sparse extremizer attained at genus ten.
